ObjectName.value: Catholic Confirmation Ceremony at St. Michael the Archangel Parish, Chang'ombe - September 15, 2012

ImageDescription.value:
A solemn moment during the celebration of the Sacrament of Confirmation on Saturday, September 15, 2012. The ceremony took place at St. Michael the Archangel Catholic Parish in Chang'ombe, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.
His Grace Bishop Eusebius Alfred Nzingilwa (then Auxiliary Bishop of the Catholic Archdiocese of Dar es Salaam and Vicar General) is administering the Sacrament of Confirmation to the candidate David Mwigani. Standing behind the candidate as sponsor (godfather) is Mr. Mathew Alex Kipeta.
